- name: tiktok_ads__ad_group_report
      description: Daily ad group performance aggregated from hourly stats with latest ad group, campaign, and advertiser attributes plus CPC/CPM/CTR metrics.
      grain: One row per date_day per source_relation per advertiser_id per campaign_id per ad_group_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_group_report_hourly
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_group_history_latest
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__advertiser
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__campaign_history_latest
      business_logic: '- Begin with hourly facts from intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_group_report_hourly. - Derive date_day by converting stat_time_hour to a calendar date (time removed). - Left join latest ad group attributes on ad_group_id; then left join advertiser on advertiser_id; then left join latest campaign on campaign_id. - Group by: source_relation, date_day, advertiser_id, advertiser_name, campaign_id, campaign_name, ad_group_id, ad_group_name, currency, interest_category, gender, audience_type, budget. - For all activity metrics, aggregate daily values by summing hourly inputs; NULL inputs are ignored and the sum is NULL if all inputs are NULL. - total_conversion_value is the daily sum of row-level (purchase value + sales lead value); rows where either term is NULL yield NULL for that row and are omitted from the sum; result is NULL if all rows are NULL. - Rate metrics: - daily_cpc: total spend divided by total clicks; returns NULL when total clicks is zero or NULL; unit is currency per click; no rounding. - daily_cpm: total spend divided by total impressions, scaled per 1,000 impressions; returns NULL when total impressions is zero or NULL; unit is currency per 1,000 impressions; no rounding. - daily_ctr: total clicks divided by total impressions, expressed as a percentage; returns NULL when total impressions is zero or NULL; no rounding. - All joins are LEFT, so missing dimension records do not suppress fact aggregation; unmatched dimension fields remain NULL. - No explicit ordering is applied to the output.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: tiktok_ads__ad_report
      description: Daily ad performance aggregated from hourly with latest ad/ad group/campaign/advertiser attributes (no URL breakdown)
      grain: One row per source_relation, date_day, ad_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_report_hourly (stat_time_hour, source_relation, ad_id, impressions, clicks, spend, reach, conversion, likes, comments, shares, profile_visits, follows, video_watched_2_s, video_watched_6_s, video_views_p_25, video_views_p_50, video_views_p_75, real_time_conversion, total_purchase_value, total_sales_lead_value)
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_history_latest (ad_id, ad_name, ad_group_id, advertiser_id, campaign_id, source_relation)
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_group_history_latest (ad_group_id, ad_group_name, advertiser_id, interest_category, gender, audience_type, budget, source_relation)
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__advertiser (advertiser_id, advertiser_name, currency)
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__campaign_history_latest (campaign_id, campaign_name, source_relation)
      business_logic: '- Start from hourly facts; derive date_day by converting the hourly timestamp to its calendar date. - Join latest dimensions: - ads on matching ad_id - ad_groups on matching ad_group_id and source_relation - advertiser on matching advertiser_id - campaigns on matching campaign_id and source_relation - Group by source_relation, date_day, advertiser_id, advertiser_name, campaign_id, campaign_name, ad_group_id, ad_group_name, ad_id, ad_name, currency, interest_category, gender, audience_type, budget. - For each group, aggregate all hourly metrics by summing; sums ignore NULL inputs and return NULL if all inputs are NULL; no additional casting or rounding. - Compute rate metrics from the aggregated sums with zero-safe division: - daily_cpc: total spend divided by total clicks - daily_cpm: total spend divided by total impressions, scaled per 1,000 impressions - daily_ctr: total clicks divided by total impressions, expressed as a percentage If a denominator is zero or NULL, the result is NULL; no rounding is applied. - total_conversion_value is the daily sum of each hour’s (purchase value + sales lead value), equivalent to summing both components separately. - Dimension attributes come from the latest snapshots; if a joined record is missing, the attribute is NULL. All such attributes are included in the GROUP BY.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier of the data source; grouping key
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date derived from stat_time_hour
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: advertiser_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertiser ID from the latest ad group record; NULL if ad group is missing
      - name: advertiser_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertiser name from the latest advertiser record; NULL if advertiser is missing
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign ID from the latest campaign record joined on source_relation; NULL if missing
      - name: campaign_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign name from the latest campaign record; NULL if missing
      - name: ad_group_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad group ID from the latest ad group record joined on source_relation; NULL if missing
      - name: ad_group_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad group name from the latest ad group record; NULL if missing
      - name: ad_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad ID from hourly facts; grouping key
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: ad_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad name from the latest ad record; NULL if missing
      - name: currency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertiser currency code used for spend-derived metrics
      - name: interest_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Interest category from the latest ad group record
      - name: gender
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Target gender from the latest ad group record
      - name: audience_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Audience type from the latest ad group record
      - name: budget
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Ad group budget from the latest snapshot; included in grouping without aggregation
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly impressions
      - name: clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly clicks
      - name: spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily sum of hourly spend in advertiser currency
      - name: reach
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly reach
      - name: conversion
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly conversions
      - name: likes
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly likes
      - name: comments
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly comments
      - name: shares
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly shares
      - name: profile_visits
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly profile visits
      - name: follows
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly follows
      - name: video_watched_2_s
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly 2-second video plays
      - name: video_watched_6_s
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly 6-second video plays
      - name: video_views_p_25
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly 25% video views
      - name: video_views_p_50
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly 50% video views
      - name: video_views_p_75
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly 75% video views
      - name: real_time_conversion
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Daily sum of hourly real-time conversions
      - name: total_purchase_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily sum of hourly purchase value
      - name: total_sales_lead_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily sum of hourly sales lead value
      - name: total_conversion_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily sum of each hour’s purchase value plus sales lead value
      - name: daily_cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total spend divided by total clicks; NULL if clicks are zero or NULL; no rounding
      - name: daily_cpm
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total spend per 1,000 impressions; NULL if impressions are zero or NULL; no rounding
      - name: daily_ctr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Click-through rate as clicks divided by impressions times 100; NULL if impressions are zero or NULL; no rounding

blocks.original_text:
- name: tiktok_ads__advertiser_report
      description: Daily advertiser performance aggregated from hourly ad reports with advertiser attributes
      grain: One row per source_relation, date_day, advertiser_id, advertiser_name, currency
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_report_hourly
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__advertiser
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_history_latest
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_report_hourly (hourly). - Derive date_day by taking the calendar date from stat_time_hour (cast to date); no timezone adjustments. - Left join to intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_history_latest (ads) on ad_id and source_relation; unmatched hourly rows are kept and advertiser_id may be NULL; multiple matches in ads duplicate rows and thus their measures. - Left join to intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__advertiser (advertiser) on advertiser_id and source_relation; unmatched rows are kept and advertiser_name and currency may be NULL; multiple matches in advertiser duplicate rows and thus their measures. - Group by source_relation, date_day, advertiser_id, advertiser_name, currency to produce one row per combination. - For each group, compute totals for clicks, impressions, spend, reach, conversion, likes, comments, shares, profile_visits, follows, video_watched_2_s, video_watched_6_s, video_views_p_25, video_views_p_50, video_views_p_75, real_time_conversion, total_purchase_value, and total_sales_lead_value by summing the corresponding hourly values; missing inputs are ignored; the total is NULL if all inputs are missing. - total_conversion_value is the sum across the group of (purchase value + sales lead value) evaluated per row; if either component of a row is missing, that row does not contribute; the result is NULL if no row contributes. - daily_cpc divides the group’s total spend by the group’s total clicks; if total clicks are zero or missing, the result is NULL; no rounding. - daily_cpm divides the group’s total spend by the group’s total impressions and multiplies by 1000; if total impressions are zero or missing, the result is NULL; no rounding. - daily_ctr divides the group’s total clicks by the group’s total impressions and multiplies by 100; if total impressions are zero or missing, the result is NULL; no rounding; expressed as a percentage.'

        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source identifier used for joining and grouping
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE

        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: advertiser_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertiser ID from ad history; may be NULL when no match
      - name: advertiser_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertiser name from advertiser data; may be NULL
      - name: currency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertiser currency from advertiser data; may be NULL
      - name: clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total clicks for the group
        tests:
        - clicks >= 0
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total impressions for the group
        tests:
        - impressions >= 0
      - name: spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total spend for the group; unrounded
        tests:
        - spend >= 0
      - name: reach
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total reach for the group
        tests:
        - reach >= 0

        description: Total conversions for the group
        tests:
        - conversion >= 0
      - name: likes
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total likes for the group
        tests:
        - likes >= 0
      - name: comments

        description: Total comments for the group
        tests:
        - comments >= 0
      - name: shares

        description: Total shares for the group
        tests:
        - shares >= 0
      - name: profile_visits
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total profile visits for the group
        tests:
        - profile_visits >= 0
      - name: follows
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total follows for the group
        tests:
        - follows >= 0
      - name: video_watched_2_s
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total 2-second video watches for the group
        tests:
        - video_watched_2_s >= 0
      - name: video_watched_6_s
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total 6-second video watches for the group
        tests:
        - video_watched_6_s >= 0
      - name: video_views_p_25
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total video views reaching 25% for the group
        tests:
        - video_views_p_25 >= 0
      - name: video_views_p_50
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total video views reaching 50% for the group
        tests:
        - video_views_p_50 >= 0
      - name: video_views_p_75
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total video views reaching 75% for the group
        tests:
        - video_views_p_75 >= 0
      - name: real_time_conversion
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total real-time conversions for the group
        tests:
        - real_time_conversion >= 0
      - name: total_purchase_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total purchase value for the group; unrounded
        tests:
        - total_purchase_value >= 0
      - name: total_sales_lead_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total sales lead value for the group; unrounded
        tests:
        - total_sales_lead_value >= 0
      - name: total_conversion_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of per-row purchase value plus sales lead value across the group; unrounded
        tests:
        - total_conversion_value >= 0
      - name: daily_cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Group total spend divided by group total clicks; NULL when clicks are zero or missing; unrounded
        tests:
        - daily_cpc >= 0
      - name: daily_cpm
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Group total spend divided by group total impressions times 1000; NULL when impressions are zero or missing; unrounded
        tests:
        - daily_cpm >= 0
      - name: daily_ctr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Group total clicks divided by group total impressions times 100; NULL when impressions are zero or missing; unrounded; percentage
        tests:
        - daily_ctr BETWEEN 0 AND 100

- name: tiktok_ads__campaign_country_report
      description: Daily TikTok Ads campaign performance aggregated by campaign and country with latest campaign and advertiser attributes
      grain: One row per source_relation, date_day, campaign_id, and country_code
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__campaign_country_report
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__campaign_history_latest

      business_logic: '- Start from country_report and rename stat_time_day to date_day; retain source_relation, campaign_id, country_code, clicks, impressions, spend, conversion, and real_time_conversion. - Left join campaigns by campaign_id to attach the latest campaign_name, campaign_type, created_at, objective_type, status, split_test_variable, budget, and budget_mode. - Left join advertiser by campaigns.advertiser_id to attach advertiser_id, advertiser_name, and currency. - Aggregate at the combination of source_relation, date_day, campaign_id, and country_code. Joined campaign and advertiser attributes are carried through for each group; if no match, those attributes are NULL. - For each group, compute totals for clicks, impressions, spend, conversion, and real_time_conversion by summing the respective values; NULL inputs are ignored, and if all inputs are NULL the total is NULL. - Derived metrics: - daily_cpc: total spend divided by total clicks; result is NULL if total clicks is 0 or NULL. - daily_cpm: total spend divided by total impressions, then multiplied by 1,000; result is NULL if total impressions is 0 or NULL. - daily_ctr: total clicks divided by total impressions, then multiplied by 100; result is NULL if total impressions is 0 or NULL. - No rounding or formatting is applied; monetary values are interpreted in the advertiser’s currency. All source rows contribute to totals; no de-duplication is performed.'

      description: Daily ad performance with URL breakdown; includes only ads whose landing_page_url is non-null
      grain: One row per unique combination of date_day, source_relation, ad_id, ad_group_id, campaign_id, and grouped context fields (advertiser_id/name, campaign_name, ad_group_name, ad_name, currency, interest_category, gender, audience_type, budget, base_url, url_host, url_path, utm_source/medium/campaign/content/term)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_report_hourly
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_history_latest
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_group_history_latest
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__advertiser
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__campaign_history_latest
      business_logic: '1) Start from intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_report_hourly (hourly). 2) Left join latest dimension snapshots: - hourly.ad_id → intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_history_latest (ads) - ads.ad_group_id → intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_group_history_latest (ad_groups) - ads.advertiser_id → intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__advertiser (advertiser) - ads.campaign_id → intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__campaign_history_latest (campaigns) 3) Keep only rows where ads.landing_page_url is present (non-null). 4) Derive date_day by casting hourly.stat_time_hour to a date (no timezone adjustments). 5) Group by all selected dimensions: source_relation, date_day, advertiser_id/name, campaign_id/name, ad_group_id/name, ad_id, ad_name, base_url, url_host, url_path, utm_source/medium/campaign/content/term, currency, interest_category, gender, audience_type, budget. 6) For each group, add up all hourly numeric metrics; null inputs are ignored in the addition, and if all inputs are null the result is null. For total_conversion_value, first compute purchase value plus sales lead value per row, then add those row results across the group; if either component is missing on a row, that row contributes nothing. 7) Compute rate metrics from the aggregated totals: - daily_cpc: total spend divided by total clicks; if total clicks is zero or null, return null; no rounding. - daily_cpm: total spend divided by total impressions, multiplied by 1000; if total impressions is zero or null, return null; no rounding. - daily_ctr: total clicks divided by total impressions, multiplied by 100; if total impressions is zero or null, return null; no rounding. 8) URL and UTM fields are taken directly from ads without parsing, normalization, trimming, or case changes. 9) Context fields (currency, interest_category, gender, audience_type, budget) are grouping keys; differences create separate rows.'

For total_conversion_value, first compute purchase value plus sales lead value per row, then add those row results across the group; if either component is missing on a row, that row contributes nothing. 7) Compute rate metrics from the aggregated totals: - daily_cpc: total spend divided by total clicks; if total clicks is zero or null, return null; no rounding. - daily_cpm: total spend divided by total impressions, multiplied by 1000; if total impressions is zero or null, return null; no rounding. - daily_ctr: total clicks divided by total impressions, multiplied by 100; if total impressions is zero or null, return null; no rounding. 8) URL and UTM fields are taken directly from ads without parsing, normalization, trimming, or case changes. 9) Context fields (currency, interest_category, gender, audience_type, budget) are grouping keys; differences create separate rows.'
